title: Kibi Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Kibi knowledge base

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema identifier for editor/schema tooling

scenarios.description: Path to BDD scenario markdown files

tests.description: Path to test specification markdown files

adr.description: Path to Architecture Decision Record markdown files

flags.description: Path to feature flag markdown files

events.description: Path to domain event markdown files

facts.description: Path to atomic fact markdown files

defaultBranch.description: [DEPRECATED] No longer used. Branch lifecycle now follows git naturally without requiring a configured default. This field is ignored but kept for backward compatibility.

rules.description: Enable/disable individual validation rules. All rules default to true.

must-priority-coverage.description: Every must-priority requirement must have at least one scenario and one test

symbol-coverage.description: Symbols should be traceable to requirements via transitive implements relationships

symbol-traceability.description: Source symbols must have direct implements links to requirements (and optionally ADR constraints)

no-dangling-refs.description: All relationship targets must exist in the KB

no-cycles.description: No circular dependency chains in requirements

required-fields.description: All entities must have required fields (id, title, status, created_at, updated_at, source)

deprecated-adr-no-successor.description: Deprecated ADRs must have a successor ADR that supersedes them

domain-contradictions.description: Detect contradictions between requirements constraining the same fact

strict-fact-shape.description: Detect malformed strict facts (facts with fact_kind that are missing required fields)

requireAdr.description: If true, symbols must also have a direct constrained_by relationship to an ADR
